attributes.name: Disciple of the Forgotten Pharaoh
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each character at your location summons and encounters the henchman Forgotten Pharaoh Cultist.

If undefeated, each character at your location suffers a scourge. Then discard a card from the blessings deck.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
